# 1. Scope & Objective
Analyzes the internal coauthorship and funding structure of researchers supported by the Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung across its diverse scientific funding lines (Memorial Stipendien, Forschungskollegs, Schlüsselprojekte, First-in-HUMAN, Translationale Projekte).
